title: Allow adding an additional admin for the owner-only Enquiries page

requirements.text: Add backend support to manage multiple enquiry admins by storing an editable, persistent list of authorized admin emails (instead of a hardcoded constant list) and using it for enquiry authorization checks.

quotes:
Ya I want to add one more admin.
What it will require to add one more admin?

acceptanceCriteria: Authorized admin emails are stored in a persistent (upgrade-safe) state variable initialized with the current default emails.
Backend enquiry authorization checks (view enquiries / mark answered / isAdminEnquiryAccess) use the persistent authorized email list.
If an unauthorized caller attempts to modify the authorized email list, the backend rejects the request with an appropriate trap message.

requirements.text: Expose backend admin-management APIs for enquiries access: list authorized admin emails, add an authorized admin email, and remove an authorized admin email.

quotes:
Ya I want to add one more admin.
What it will require to add one more admin?

acceptanceCriteria: A query method returns the current authorized admin email list.
A shared method allows an authorized admin to add a new email; emails are normalized for case-insensitive comparison and duplicates are prevented.
A shared method allows an authorized admin to remove an email; removal is case-insensitive and the resulting list is persisted.
All methods validate that the provided email is non-empty after trimming; invalid inputs are rejected.

requirements.text: Add a frontend admin management section on the Enquiries dashboard that allows an authorized admin to add and remove authorized admin emails.

quotes:
Ya I want to add one more admin.
What it will require to add one more admin?

acceptanceCriteria: When the current user is authorized for enquiries, the Enquiries dashboard displays an “Admin Access” (or similar) panel showing the current authorized admin email list.
The panel provides an input + button to add a new admin email and shows success/error toasts based on the result.
Each listed email has a remove action (with a simple confirmation) that removes it and refreshes the list.
The UI disables actions while requests are in-flight and handles backend errors gracefully.

requirements.text: Update the frontend authorization/diagnostic logic so it does not rely on a hardcoded admin email list; it should instead use the backend-managed email list for any “Email Authorized” diagnostics shown in the Access Denied view.

quotes:
Ya I want to add one more admin.
What it will require to add one more admin?

acceptanceCriteria: The app no longer needs to keep the backend and frontend admin email lists manually in sync for authorization diagnostics.
In the Access Denied screen, the “Email Authorized: Yes/No” determination is based on the backend-managed list (fetched from the backend), not a local constant.

requirements.text: Add clear user-facing guidance on the Enquiries login/access screen describing what is required for a new admin to gain access: the new admin must log in with Internet Identity and set their profile email to the authorized email that the owner/admin has added.

quotes: What it will require to add one more admin?

acceptanceCriteria: The Enquiries view includes a short explanation (English) stating that access is granted by authorizing an email and that the admin must log in with Internet Identity and save a matching profile email.
Copy is concise and appears near the login/profile completion flow where users are most likely to need it.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).

Do not edit frontend files under immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Use Internet Identity only (no passwords/passkeys implemented separately).
nonGoals: Creating role-based permissions beyond enquiry-admin email authorization (e.g., per-action roles).
Adding real-time updates or notifications for new enquiries.
